text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Ibuprofen can increase plasma lithium levels and reduce its renal clearance, which raises the risk of lithium toxicity [ibuprofen:drug_interactions:2, ibuprofen:drug_interactions:3, lithium:drug_interactions:0]. This interaction is attributed to the inhibition of renal prostaglandin synthesis by ibuprofen [ibuprofen:drug_interactions:2, ibuprofen:drug_interactions:3]. When these drugs are given together, patients require careful observation for signs of toxicity and more frequent monitoring of serum lithium concentrations [ibuprofen:drug_interactions:3, lithium:drug_interactions:0].
